name: [🤑WORKS] PLS WAIT 💸
desc:
➡️ With PLS WAIT, you can continue earning Robux after the Roblox update! Join the game to see how it works! 💰

😴 Welcome to PLS WAIT! (Donation Game) 💸 The longer you play, the more likely you are to earn Robux. Donating to players earns you points, and the longer they have played, the more points you get! Spend points on power-ups to mess with other players, or global events that occur in every server!

❓ How do I play PLS WAIT?
• Claim a stand 🏪
• Personalize your stand text ✏️
• Receive Robux from other players 💸
• Donate Robux to other players 🎁

💵 Join our community:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/16290792
